verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs say entitlements are linked to plans or items, with access granted automatically on subscription, and can be checked in real time via the Recurly API. That covers the core of the story. However, no evidence shows that numeric limits or quotas can be modeled as entitlements, or that the SDKs expose entitlement checks; the client libraries are listed only generically. missing for 10: modeling of limits/quotas as entitlements, SDK-level entitlement check methods, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, features and limits are modeled as entitlements attached to plans, and my application can check a customer's entitlements at runtime via API or SDK

citations.quote: Link entitlements to plans or items — when a customer subscribes, access is granted automatically.
Entitlements can be applied across platforms (web, mobile, and app stores) and checked in real time via the Recurly API.
